title: Services
lead: Healing is a process in which deeper layers are resolved with each treatment, so I recommend at least four sessions. That said, even a single treatment can bring profound relief and one-off sessions are welcome.

cards.title: Introductory Call
cards.text: A short call to explore what you’re looking for and whether my approach is a good fit before we begin working together. Schedule via [WhatsApp](whatsapp) or [Email](email).

cards.title: Healing Treatment
cards.text: Healing sessions to resolve imbalances in your energy system, addressing areas of discomfort in your life to facilitate your healing process and bring you back in touch with your Soul. Comprises Energy Healing and/or Reiki depending on your needs and preferences.

cards.title: Healing and Counselling
cards.text: Longer sessions comprising an Energy Healing treatment and counselling. By exploring what is present for you (thoughts, emotions, patterns, needs, values), you gain insight to better understand yourself and your unique healing process.
